<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<configuration>
    <!-- Console appender with JSON format for cloud environments -->
    <appender name="CONSOLE_JSON" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
        <encoder class="net.logstash.logback.encoder.LogstashEncoder">
            <!-- Add custom fields for cloud tracing -->
            <includeMdcKeyName>traceId</includeMdcKeyName>
            <includeMdcKeyName>instanceId</includeMdcKeyName>
            <includeMdcKeyName>operation</includeMdcKeyName>
            <includeMdcKeyName>requestId</includeMdcKeyName>

            <!-- Custom fields for AWS CloudWatch -->
            <customFields>{"application":"mini-java-app","environment":"${ENVIRONMENT:-production}"}</customFields>

            <!-- Include stack traces for errors -->
            <throwableConverter class="net.logstash.logback.stacktrace.ShortenedThrowableConverter">
                <maxDepthPerThrowable>30</maxDepthPerThrowable>
                <maxLength>2048</maxLength>
                <shortenedClassNameLength>20</shortenedClassNameLength>
                <exclude>sun\.reflect\..*</exclude>
                <exclude>net\.sf\.cglib\..*</exclude>
                <rootCauseFirst>true</rootCauseFirst>
            </throwableConverter>
        </encoder>
    </appender>

    <!-- Console appender with plain text format for local development -->
    <appender name="CONSOLE_PLAIN" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
        <encoder>
            <pattern>%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} [%X{traceId:-no-trace}] [%X{instanceId:-no-instance}] - %msg%n</pattern>
        </encoder>
    </appender>

    <!-- Choose JSON or plain based on environment variable -->
    <if condition='property("LOG_FORMAT").equals("json")'>
        <then>
            <appender name="CONSOLE" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
                <encoder class="net.logstash.logback.encoder.LogstashEncoder">
                    <includeMdcKeyName>traceId</includeMdcKeyName>
                    <includeMdcKeyName>instanceId</includeMdcKeyName>
                    <includeMdcKeyName>operation</includeMdcKeyName>
                    <includeMdcKeyName>requestId</includeMdcKeyName>
                    <customFields>{"application":"mini-java-app","environment":"${ENVIRONMENT:-production}"}</customFields>
                </encoder>
            </appender>
        </then>
        <else>
            <appender name="CONSOLE" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
                <encoder>
                    <pattern>%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} [%X{traceId:-no-trace}] - %msg%n</pattern>
                </encoder>
            </appender>
        </else>
    </if>

    <!-- Default to JSON for cloud environments -->
    <root level="${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}">
        <appender-ref ref="CONSOLE_JSON" />
    </root>

    <!-- Reduce noise from Spring and Hibernate -->
    <logger name="org.springframework" level="WARN"/>
    <logger name="org.hibernate" level="WARN"/>
    <logger name="com.zaxxer.hikari" level="INFO"/>

    <!-- Application loggers -->
    <logger name="com.test" level="${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}"/>
</configuration>
